recent_posts.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio adds identity and user management features
recent_posts.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now offers expanded identity and user management capabilities for administrators. IAM domain admins can configure AWS IAM Identity Center for SSO, add various IAM principals as project members, and access a consolidated domain user management page. Identity Center domain users can now federate via IAM roles with unique sessions per user, preventing work overwrites and enabling per-user audit trails. These features provide flexibility for teams to collaborate regardless of authentication method, and are available across 15 AWS regions.

recent_posts.title: AWS Capabilities by Region now supports availability notifications
recent_posts.summary: AWS has launched availability notifications for the AWS Capabilities by Region tool in AWS Builder Center. This subscription-based system automatically alerts users when AWS services or features become available in their target regions. Builders can subscribe at the service level, and notifications are delivered via in-app alerts and a weekly email digest. The feature covers 1,500+ services and features across 37 AWS regions and is free for all authenticated users with a Builder ID.

recent_posts.title: AWS India customers can now use UPI Scan and Pay for sign-up and payments
recent_posts.summary: AWS India customers can now use UPI Scan and Pay to sign up for AWS or pay invoices. The feature lets customers scan a QR code displayed in the AWS Console using UPI apps like Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, or Amazon Pay, removing the need to manually enter a UPI ID. It also supports UPI AutoPay for automatic monthly payments up to INR 15,000.

recent_posts.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports VPC egress for private connectivity to resources in your VPC
recent_posts.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Service has added a VPC egress option that enables VPC-based domains to establish private network connections to resources within your VPC — such as ML models, AWS services, and custom applications — without routing traffic over the public internet. When enabled, OpenSearch Service adds network interfaces to your selected subnets and routes outbound traffic into your VPC. The feature can be configured via the AWS Console, CLI, or API (CreateDomain/UpdateDomainConfig) and is available in all AWS Regions where OpenSearch Service is supported.

recent_posts.title: Agents that transact: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore now includes Payments (preview)
recent_posts.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore now includes a payments capability in preview, enabling AI agents to autonomously pay for APIs, MCP servers, web content, and other agents. Built with Coinbase and Stripe, it supports Coinbase CDP wallets and Stripe Privy wallets, enforces session-level spending limits at the infrastructure layer, and handles the full x402 protocol payment lifecycle — from wallet authentication to stablecoin transaction execution — without interrupting the agent's reasoning loop. Over 10,000 x402 endpoints are discoverable via the Coinbase x402 Bazaar MCP server through AgentCore Gateway. Available in preview across four AWS regions.

recent_posts.title: AWS Site-to-Site VPN now supports modifying tunnel bandwidth on existing VPN connections
recent_posts.summary: AWS Site-to-Site VPN now allows modifying tunnel bandwidth between standard (up to 1.25 Gbps) and large (up to 5 Gbps) tiers on existing connections without recreating them. Previously, changing bandwidth required deleting and recreating the connection, which changed tunnel IP addresses and required updating on-premises VPN device configurations and firewall rules. The new feature preserves IP addresses, CIDR blocks, pre-shared keys, and all configuration settings during the upgrade, eliminating the need for on-premises device changes. The feature is available across most major AWS regions globally.

recent_posts.title: Amazon EC2 P6-B300 instances are now available in the US East (N. Virginia) Region
recent_posts.summary: Amazon EC2 P6-B300 instances are now available in the US East (N. Virginia) Region, joining US West (Oregon) and AWS GovCloud (US-East). These instances feature 8x NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs with 2.1 TB high-bandwidth GPU memory, 6.4 Tbps EFA networking, 300 Gbps ENA throughput, and 4 TB system memory. Compared to P6-B200 instances, they deliver 2x networking bandwidth, 1.5x GPU memory, and 1.5x GPU TFLOPS (FP4, without sparsity), making them suited for training and deploying large trillion-parameter foundation models and LLMs.

recent_posts.title: AWS Marketplace now supports programmatic procurement with Agreements API
recent_posts.summary: AWS Marketplace has launched the Agreements API, allowing organizations to programmatically procure products and manage agreements. The API supports generating estimates, accepting offers, tracking charges and entitlements, updating purchase orders, and managing agreements within existing tools. Combined with the existing Discovery API, it enables an end-to-end procurement workflow from product discovery to purchase. Partners can also use it to build custom storefronts. Currently available in the US East (N. Virginia) Region, it requires IAM permissions and can be accessed via the AWS SDK.

recent_posts.title: Amazon Neptune now supports 1-click connect with CloudShell
recent_posts.summary: Amazon Neptune now supports 1-click connect via CloudShell, eliminating the need for manual network configuration and access permission setup when connecting to Neptune Database and Neptune Analytics. This feature works across different network configurations including VPC-only resources, and is especially useful for testing, development, and troubleshooting workflows. It is available at no additional charge in all regions where Neptune is offered.

recent_posts.title: The AWS MCP Server is now generally available
recent_posts.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of the AWS MCP Server, a managed remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI coding agents and assistants secure, authenticated access to all AWS services. Key features include a `call_aws` tool covering 15,000+ AWS API operations, `search_documentation` and `read_documentation` tools for up-to-date AWS docs, and a new `run_script` tool that executes sandboxed Python server-side. The server uses IAM and SigV4 authentication bridged via an open-source MCP proxy for OAuth 2.1 compatibility. Enterprise features include IAM-based permission separation between humans and agents, CloudWatch metrics under the `AWS-MCP` namespace, and CloudTrail audit logging. The server is available in US East (N. Virginia) and Europe (Frankfurt) at no additional charge beyond normal AWS resource costs, and works with Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Codex, and any MCP-compatible client.

top_posts.title: Express.js developers can now add authorization in minutes with Amazon Verified Permissions
top_posts.summary: AWS released an open source JavaScript package that enables Express.js developers to implement authorization using Amazon Verified Permissions and Cedar policies. The package moves authorization logic outside application code into externally managed policies, allowing developers to define role-based access controls without embedding complex authorization logic. The integration works through middleware that validates permissions before processing API requests, and policies can be updated without modifying application code.

top_posts.title: Amazon RDS for MariaDB now supports community MariaDB minor versions 10.11.13 and 11.4.7
top_posts.summary: AWS RDS now supports MariaDB minor versions 10.11.13 and 11.4.7, bringing security fixes, bug fixes, and performance improvements. Users can upgrade automatically during maintenance windows or use Blue/Green deployments for safer updates with minimal downtime.

top_posts.title: Fine tune a generative AI application for Amazon Bedrock using Amazon SageMaker Pipeline decorators
top_posts.summary: Building deployment pipelines for generative AI applications is complex due to continuous data processing and model updates. Amazon SageMaker Pipelines helps manage these tasks by allowing the conversion of local ML code into scalable and reusable pipeline steps. Using Python and SageMaker Pipelines decorators, developers can efficiently preprocess, train, and deploy models. SageMaker facilitates cross-functional collaboration and offers integrated tools for model versioning, lineage tracking, and end-to-end workflow management. The solution showcased converts a Python program into a SageMaker pipeline for fine-tuning a large language model using Amazon Bedrock APIs, emphasizing operational efficiency in ML projects.

top_posts.title: Amazon S3 will no longer charge for several HTTP error codes
top_posts.summary: Amazon S3 will no longer charge for unauthorized requests and certain HTTP error codes. This billing change applies to all S3 buckets and AWS Regions.

top_posts.title: Build a gen AI–powered financial assistant with Amazon Bedrock multi-agent collaboration
top_posts.summary: Amazon Bedrock empowers the development of AI-powered financial assistants through a multi-agent collaboration framework. This approach utilizes specialized agents for tasks such as portfolio creation, company research, and communication, enhancing and streamlining financial analysis. The framework's modular architecture allows for efficient updates and scalability, making it adaptable to evolving financial industries. Such systems demonstrate significant advantages in financial decision-making and complex data processing operations.
